subject: Startups
title: Sequoia's WhatsApp Gamble
description: Learn Sequoia's WhatsApp Gamble in one minute.

hook.text: Sequoia invested $60 million in WhatsApp. Facebook bought it for $22 billion. That's a 50x return on one deal.

buildup.text: WhatsApp had no ads, no games, and minimal revenue. It charged users $1 per year. Most VCs passed on it.

discovery.text: Sequoia's Jim Goetz saw the engagement data: 450 million active users who opened the app every single day.

twist.text: WhatsApp had only 55 employees when Facebook acquired it. Fifty-five people building a $22 billion product.

climax.text: Sequoia's WhatsApp bet returned more profit than most VC funds earn in their entire lifetime.

quiz.question: How many employees did WhatsApp have when Facebook acquired it?
